reason: Visually okay, some scale problems, obeying traffic lights... but otherwise mostly wrong.

collision-avoidance.detail: Cars seem to overlap without consequence, and do not stop or try to avoid collisions.

signal-compliance.detail: Generally speaking, the stoplights seem to be doing their job and the cars seem to be obeying them, but cars drive around them.

lane-discipline.detail: There isn't even road discipline, the card drive off-road diagonally to destinations on other roads

physical-scale.detail: The roads are way to wide for the car size, although the lane markings look more appropriately sized

trip-integrity.detail: I cannot visually tell where cars are attempting to go.
